context: Asuka lectures on how cultures spread.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: history lecture; vocabulary (進出/最適/概要/正式/やがて) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昔、人々は新しい土地へ進出しました。
lines.en: Long ago, people advanced into new lands.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 進出の理由は、何だったんですか?
lines.en: What were the reasons for the expansion?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 最適な土地を、求めたからです。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日の授業の概要は、それですか?
lines.en: Is that the overview of today's lesson?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、まず概要から説明しますね。
lines.en: Yes, I'll explain from the overview first.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 正式な記録も、残っているんですか?
lines.style: thoughtful teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 正式な文書が、いくつも残っています。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: やがて、文化が広がったんですね。
lines.style: moved teen boy voice, soft warm realization throughout
